make test clean
features.notes: DollarsPerPass + ParetoFrontier + FinishReasons added to SweetSpotRow with computation in BuildSweetSpot. SweetSpotGlobal added to DashboardJSON type. renderSweetSpotRow helper produces stable camelCase-keyed map. End-to-end smoke against eval_results/m_eval_sweet_spot_hard confirmed: deepseek-v4-flash $0.0243/pass + claude-haiku-4-5 $0.0592/pass both Pareto-optimal; gemma and kimi correctly marked dominated. 5 new unit tests + all 11 existing sweet_spot tests pass.
